title: Stuffed Dates with German Cheese
description: A German-inspired dessert featuring medjool dates stuffed with a creamy delight cheese mixture.
instructions: Cut a slit in each date to create a pocket.
In a bowl, mix together cream cheese, delight cheese, and powdered sugar until smooth.
Add vanilla extract and mix well.
Stuff each date with the cheese mixture.
Place the stuffed dates on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the dates are caramelized.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
